name: fastboot
description: Android fastboot protocol tool for bootloader flashing and device management

fastboot.description: Android fastboot protocol tool for bootloader flashing and device management
fastboot.usage:
fastboot devices # List devices in fastboot mode
fastboot flash boot boot.img # Flash boot partition
fastboot oem unlock # Unlock bootloader
fastboot reboot # Reboot device
fastboot getvar all # Get device variables
